n2_rebirth_bj: Stream entry’s greatest prize is a “release date”: AN 3.88 allows at most seven more lives before final awakening. There is actually quite a lot of modern academic evidence for rebirth. But who’s going around getting reborn if no permanent self exists? Buddhists don’t imagine any permanent self-essence/soul moving between bodies. Rather, rebirth is seen as a causal process: there is a continuity (often called a “mind-stream”), but there is not a “thing” that’s moving from one life to the next. Craving and clinging lead to becoming, and becoming leads to birth. More like a driverless car. The later Buddhist philosopher Milindapañha compared rebirth to one lamp being used to lighting another.
